description.value: My Greek Taverna is a family-style Greek restaurant in Coquitlam's Brunette Avenue corridor, serving traditional Mediterranean dishes including souvlaki, moussaka, rack of lamb, and fresh seafood prepared with time-honored recipes. The cozy, rustic dining room is designed to evoke an authentic Greek atmosphere. Touring cyclists will find satisfying, protein-rich plated meals with generous accompaniments of Greek salad, rice, roast potato, and pita bread.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms this is an active Greek restaurant in Coquitlam with matching phone number (604-525-5351) and URL. The menu is fully rendered and includes vegetarian dishes such as Spanakopita Dinner and Tyropita Dinner, confirming at least partial vegetarian options. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: Website prominently notes a seasonal closure ('We will be closed from August 16 until September 2 and will reopen on September 3rd'). No year is given; this appears to be an annual summer break. Not indicative of permanent closure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Greek restaurant with an active website and confirmed contact details. A legitimate dining stop for touring cyclists seeking a full sit-down meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Spanakopita Dinner (fillo pastry with spinach & feta), Tyropita Dinner (fillo pastry with feta cheese), and Saganaki Dinner (pan-fried cheese) — all vegetarian dishes

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Most entrees $27–32, premium items to $50; full sit-down with sides
